summary: App commands have no per-command allow-list; assess_file works as a file oracle for any absolute or UNC path
evidence: build.rs uses default tauri_build::build() with no AppManifest; capabilities/default.json lists only core permissions. UNVERIFIED: Tauri default-allow behaviour for app commands. VERIFIED (capabilities audit, tauri-2.12.6 src/webview/mod.rs:2076-2084): the ACL check is skipped for non-plugin commands from local pages when the app has no permission manifest, so capability entries cannot restrict the five app commands.
failure_scenario: If default-allow applies, any webview content can probe file existence and size outside the scan scope. Related to FND-0007.
